-- Slack and Jira connections made by a signed-in Nykst (GitHub) user.
-- Tokens are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM, same key handling as user_ai_keys) in `secrets`.
-- Only the server (service role) can read this table.

create table if not exists public.integration_connections (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  provider text not null default 'github',
  provider_user_id text not null,
  kind text not null check (kind in ('slack', 'jira')),
  -- Slack team id or Jira cloud id; used to find the owner of an incoming Slack command
  external_id text not null,
  label text not null default '',
  meta jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  secrets text not null,
  expires_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (provider, provider_user_id, kind)
);

create index if not exists integration_connections_external_idx
  on public.integration_connections (kind, external_id);

alter table public.integration_connections enable row level security;
revoke all on public.integration_connections from anon, authenticated;
grant all on public.integration_connections to service_role;

-- Verified Razorpay webhook events, stored for idempotency and reconciliation.
--
-- The raw payload is deliberately not stored: Razorpay payloads can contain
-- customer email, phone, card metadata and notes. Only identifiers, amounts and
-- the processing outcome are kept. No row in this table grants access.
create table if not exists public.razorpay_webhook_events (
  event_id text primary key,
  event_type text not null,
  category text not null
    check (category in ('order', 'payment', 'subscription', 'refund', 'dispute', 'unsupported')),
  status text not null default 'received'
    check (status in ('received', 'processed', 'ignored', 'failed')),
  order_id text,
  payment_id text,
  subscription_id text,
  amount integer,
  currency text,

-- Inbound mail received by the Nykst address, stored so no message is lost.
--
-- Resend signs every inbound event; /api/webhooks/resend verifies that signature

-- reference from the subject is kept when present so a reply stays on the same
-- case as the form message it answers.

-- Nothing in the browser reads or writes this table: anon and authenticated are
-- revoked, and only the service role behind the server route can touch it.

  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  resend_email_id text not null unique,
  contact_reference text,
  from_email text not null,
  to_email text not null default '',
  subject text not null default '',

  message_id text,
